items.html: Indeed, the aspect of Mayin Nukvin that we mentioned above, which ascended for the sake of the upper coupling, is itself the matter of the ascent of the seven lights above, into Bina. Remember this introduction — what is the matter of the raising of Mayin Nukvin. In this coupling, all ten Sefirot must be corrected, from Keter to Malchut, for even the three first ones are not yet corrected. Therefore, this raising of Mayin Nukvin took place above, in AV and SAG of AK.
